question: Top 5 categories by revenue last month
ground_truth_sql: SELECT category, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM catalog.schema.orders WHERE order_date >= DATEADD(month, -1, CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY category ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 5
generated_sql: SELECT category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(revenue) DESC) AS r FROM catalog.schema.orders WHERE order_date >= DATEADD(month, -1, CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY category
judge_rationale: Generated SQL uses RANK() without LIMIT; returns all categories ranked rather than top 5
expected_repair_hypothesis: Replace RANK() with ROW_NUMBER() and add LIMIT 5
